title: Silence as Strategic Leverage
voiceover_full: The most dangerous person in the room isn’t the loudest. It’s the one who says nothing. When you pause, people get uncomfortable. To stop the awkwardness, they will over-explain and negotiate against themselves. Next time you want the upper hand: ask your question, shut your mouth, and just wait.
